name: dsh-desktop-tabs
description: Desktop-shell prototype: a host tab strip anchored to the Windows caption menu, where each remote tab keeps one leased <webview> alive for as long as the tab is open (switching only hides it) and the active tab offers a refresh control beside its close button

scripts.test: node tests/remote.test.mjs && node tests/view-retention.spec.ts && node tests/clipboard-relay.spec.ts && node tests/notify-relay.spec.ts
